enchantments.tooltip: Fire Resistance +50: Passive: +50 Enhancement bonus to your Fire Resistance.
Insightful Enchantment Save +4: +4 Insight bonus to your saves versus enchantments

Insightful Proof Against Poison +4: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +4 Insight bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 5 + their Fortitude save).

Quality Proof Against Disease +2: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +2 Quality bonus to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 3 + their Fortitude save).
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
